dedupe_keys.name: 3d model of antenna system embedded into building envelope for improved cellular signal transmission through load bearing walls

description: Aalto University researchers publish the geometry and material parameters of a spiral antenna system embedded in a load-bearing wall. The February 2023 Zenodo release provides a STEP model, a text material table and an illustration under CC BY 4.0, free to download. The table defines electrical and thermal properties for copper spirals, substrate, coaxial components and the surrounding wall assembly. Frequency-dependent concrete and rockwool dielectric properties are delegated to the cited ITU-R model. These inputs can help build coupled electromagnetic and thermal simulations of building envelopes that pass cellular signals. Coverage is a generic unit cell, not a surveyed building or observation period. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model input. The internal numerical mesh is explicitly absent; solver settings, boundary conditions and material uncertainty require the describing paper. The CAD geometry was not downloaded, meshed or simulated.
